summary: These two answer different questions. The Litter-Robot 4 is the box to buy if you never want to be tied to a consumable: it takes ordinary kitchen bags, handles cats from 3 to 25 lb, and comes from the maker with the deepest support and parts network in the category. The PetSnowy SNOW+ is the box to buy if odour is the whole problem: it seals waste into a liner after every cycle and treats the air with a titanium dioxide photocatalyst. It is $100 cheaper up front, but those liners are mandatory for as long as you own it.
chooseA: You want no mandatory consumables — it takes standard kitchen bags
You have a large cat: it is rated up to 25 lb
Long-term support and spare parts matter to you
You want the option of a 3-year extended plan ($129)
chooseB: Odour containment is your top priority
You like waste sealed away after every cycle
You would rather spend $100 less at checkout
You are comfortable buying PetSnowy liners indefinitely ($49.99 per 50)
